reaction: Seeing the joined loop move is a satisfying payoff to the assembly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Threading the loop over the wheel completed the mechanism and revealed how its parts move together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the battery and switch was straightforward, but less revealing about the mechanism than joining and installing the loop.

surprise.text: The completed motion showed the red section travelling around the loop as the wheel turns.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the goals identified each part and the joiner’s purpose was clear from the separated string ends.

continue.text: I would continue to see another mechanism come together, especially if its completed motion explains what the parts do.
